reason: 该插件主要面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面性能优化：在不改动核心源码的前提下，通过注册覆盖路由、响应压缩、不可变缓存和首屏脚本预加载来优化资源传输与加载行为。README 与 manifest/包配置共同表明其为可配置的补充性能插件，功能范围集中于静态资源服务层与性能设置入口，而非业务逻辑或远程 API 扩展。

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 的性能增强插件，用于对前端资源和客户端 bundle 进行可选压缩、缓存优化和预加载注入，并提供可重启生效的设置开关。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness web performance plugin that adds optional asset/bundle compression, caching optimization, and preload hints, with restart-based settings controls for configuring behavior.

capabilities: immutable cache-control for static and bundle assets
preload link injection into HTML index
runtime configuration of web performance options
startup capability probing against upstream behavior

reasons.code: The plugin declares purpose as a DeepSeek Harness plugin that registers frontend routes and adds gzip/brotli compression plus immutable caching for assets.
It defines per-entry `/plugins/<entryId>` bundle routes with compressed `client.js`/`client.js.map` delivery while preserving route semantics.
It injects optional `<link rel="preload" ...>` hints for stage-one client bundles through index taps.
It includes startup auto-detect probes to avoid duplicating upstream optimizations already implemented by the host server.
Package metadata includes DSH bundle patch and client/web export configuration, indicating runtime plugin wiring into web profile host and client planes.
Repository contains local installer scripts and benchmark/analysis files for build and testing workflows, indicating operational and testing behavior.
